turns.text: Is there a Patient app in ABDM and how do I build one?

must_contain: Yes: the patient app is a PHR application, the patient's own app on ABDM
Building one is four ABDM milestones in order, P1, P2, P3 and P4, and the answer names all four
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, case 5: the answer explained P1's creation and login routes in full and stopped at P3. NHA asked for what a patient app is, all four milestones briefly, and a question back about which to open. The enrolment OTP path is forbidden because it marks the P1-in-depth answer.
